resumeText:
Faizan Qureshi | New Delhi | faizan.qureshi@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Legal Executive - Litigation, Rathore & Sinha Law Chambers, New Delhi (2024 - present)
- Maintain case files, briefs and order sheets for 120 active matters before the Delhi High Court and district courts.
- File petitions, applications and vakalatnamas through the Delhi High Court e-filing portal and clear registry objections.
- Check the daily cause list and update hearing dates in the matter diary.
- Draft first versions of legal notices and replies for cheque bounce and recovery matters.
- Update the litigation tracker in Excel for corporate clients every week.

Paralegal, Yamuna Legal Associates, New Delhi (2022 - 2024)
- Research judgments on SCC Online and Manupatra and prepare case law compilations for counsel.
- Prepare paper books, affidavits and indexes for filing in district courts.

EDUCATION
LLB, Faculty of Law, University of Delhi, 2022

SKILLS
Legal document review, MS Word, Excel
